name: rapier
description: Rapier gives you a document you can read, edit and keep, with your agent editing beside you. It is a Markdown editor in one offline HTML file: no server, no account, nothing collected, fast on a phone even for long documents. Your agent hands you a document as one page that opens with one click and works offline, or works in it with you: it reads only the passage it needs, changes only that, and you keep or drop each change. Diagrams and drawings are editable SVG inside the Markdown: the agent draws one, you move its boxes, it changes it again. Code and plain text too; opens Word and PDF; saves as Markdown, Word, PDF or a web page; pictures, tables, checklists, footnotes, a table of contents, light and dark. What leaves your device is the document you share with the agent and the work on it, kept in a workspace that expires after thirty idle days; your assistant's host keeps the conversation under its own policy.
